assumptions.choice: stop_loss_method defaults to "percent" and accepts "percent" or "atr"
assumptions.reason: The specification requires choosing between the 2% and 1x ATR(14) stop methods via a parameter but does not specify a default.

assumptions.choice: ATR(14) is captured when the entry order completes
assumptions.reason: This gives the stated entry-price-based ATR stop a fixed value for the trade.

assumptions.choice: A long stop is hit when Low <= stop price; a short stop is hit when High >= stop price, followed by self.close()
assumptions.reason: OHLCV bars provide High and Low for determining whether the stated stop price was reached; the canonical exit convention specifies self.close().

assumptions.choice: When enabled, an opposite momentum signal submits self.close() and a plain opposite-direction entry order
assumptions.reason: This implements reversal while retaining the canonical unstated plain self.buy()/self.sell() sizing.
